meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 与 LazyCodex 安装,揪出过时或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 LazyCodex 或 Codex,想确认本地安装健康、与最新版一致。
copy.tagline_en: Check Codex and LazyCodex installs for drift, staleness, or breakage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and worry your local install may be unhealthy or outdated.

howto.what: 请它检查本地 LazyCodex 与 Codex CLI 的安装状况:先同步最新源码,再对比版本、配置、插件并做运行探测,给出一份 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告,每条判定都附上对应的命令输出或文件作证据。它只做诊断,不改动你的安装与配置。
howto.when: 当你要求做 doctor 或健康检查、提到 LazyCodex 等名称,或 Codex 在安装、更新、改配置后行为异常时接管。

say.text: 帮我跑一次 LazyCodex doctor,看安装是否正常
say.note: 会先同步最新源码再逐项判定

say.text: Codex 刚更新完就行为怪怪的,帮我查一下原因
say.note: 会做运行探测并对照最新源码

say.text: 把本地安装和最新 LazyCodex 源码对比,看有没有漂移
say.note: 发现漂移会给出修复建议

howto.what_en: It checks your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI install against the latest sources and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report where each verdict cites its evidence. It only diagnoses; it never changes your install or config.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex and similar names, or Codex misbehaves after an install, update or config change.

say_en.text: Run a LazyCodex doctor check on my setup
say_en.note: Syncs latest sources, then rates each check

say_en.text: Codex has acted weird since the last update - please look
say_en.note: Runs a runtime probe against latest sources

say_en.text: Compare my local install with the latest LazyCodex source
